profile.tagline: I work across computer vision, machine learning, deep learning, and computer systems, with an interest in developing practical solutions to challenging engineering problems.
about: I am an M.Tech student in Computer Science and Engineering at IIT Tirupati, following a B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering from GCELT.
My interests are machine learning, computer vision, deep learning and computer systems. I enjoy implementing research-oriented projects as well as building practical software applications.
Most of all, I am drawn to the loop of research, engineering and experimentation.

points: Worked on Python image processing techniques for food adulteration detection.
Developed preprocessing and image-enhancement pipelines.
Analysed visual characteristics of food samples.
Conducted 10+ promotional campaigns.
Reached 500+ students.
Organised coding events and technical sessions.
Coordinated 15+ student volunteers.

projects.title: TCGN/CTCGN: Graph-Based Memory Prefetcher
points: Implemented a Temporal Convolutional Graph Network-based prefetcher in ChampSim.
Designed correlation-based prefetching using memory access graph modelling.
Extended it to CTCGN with context-aware cache access patterns.
Integrated at L2 cache and evaluated using SPEC CPU benchmarks.

projects.title: Biometric Attendance System
points: Led a five-member team.
Built facial-recognition-based automated attendance with group-photo recognition.
Built preprocessing, face encoding, training and recognition modules.
Integrated with an ERP backend using SQL connectivity.
